findings.title: Validator and test monolith maintainability risk

version_split_rule.v3.5.0: controls before refactor: define control surface, baseline, minimum gates, four PCACC checks, and obligation matrix; allow new controls; forbid large refactors
version_split_rule.v3.5.1: refactor only after controls are green: allow small validator split candidates; forbid new governance plane
version_split_rule.v3.5.2: maintenance policies after evidence accumulates: retention, archival, waiver registry only if data shows need; no preemptive policy bloat
version_split_rule.v3.6: structural evolution after behavior is characterized: validator split, policy registry extraction, PCACC AC coverage, validator output schema versioning; requires v3.5.x characterization tests and gates to remain green for at least one release cycle
